intro.p1: Hi! Welcome to the official David's Farm website.
intro.p2: I'm Gabriel, better known as Deon, the creator and lead developer of the project. This site exists for one simple reason: to share the game's progress with anyone curious enough to follow this journey.
intro.p3: As crazy as it sounds, David's Farm is becoming a real project. Right now, a small team of 4 developers is working on the game using C++.
intro.p4: Our goal is to release the project on PC, Mobile and Xbox Series. And... yeah, we also plan to port it to the Nintendo 3DS, PSP and a few compatible classic consoles. Don't ask why. We're not sure either.
intro.p5: In the long run, we intend to publish the game on Steam. So keep an eye on the news.

history.title: The story is going to change.
history.p2: The original David's Farm will remain the foundation of everything, but as development moves forward, some parts of the story will be rewritten, expanded or adapted. Our goal is to keep the personality of the characters and the essence of the universe that many people already know.
history.p3: The storyline involving Coed Mawr will remain an important piece of the story, but probably not exactly the way you remember it.
history.p4: Keep in mind the story is still being written. We're building the game and the universe at the same time, so a lot of ideas are still taking shape.
history.p5: But one thing I can promise: I, Gabriel, will do my very best to create a fun, dynamic and memorable adventure. So keep an eye on the news. :)

devices.title: Devices
devices.faq1q: Will the version for the new consoles arrive at the same time as the original version?
devices.faq1a2: The Xbox Series version is planned to arrive alongside the PC version.
devices.faq1a3: As for the PS5 version... well, the PS5 is ridiculously expensive. We'll see what happens.
devices.faq1a4: (And I also have no idea how to get a game onto those stores yet.)
devices.faq2q: Will the mobile version be on the Play Store?
devices.faq2a1: Gotta check with the folks over there.
devices.faq3q: Where will the PC version be downloadable?

agrinho.title: About Agrinho
agrinho.p1: Agrinho is an educational and social-responsibility program by the FAEP/SENAR-PR System, developed in partnership with the Government of Paraná, with activities and contests aimed at students and teachers.
agrinho.p2: David's Farm was originally created to compete in and win that contest. Today, however, the game has NO official, institutional, creative or commercial ties to Agrinho, to Paraná, to the FAEP/SENAR-PR System or to any related initiative.
